content: WSL2 ROCm pitfalls: rocm-smi unsupported under WSL (UKI limitation - no compute processes/utilization/state); amd-smi NOT implemented in ROCDXG (librocdxg issue #6) so no in-guest telemetry; hipMemGetInfo over-reports free VRAM excluding DRM graphics allocations (ROCm#6389); librocdxg DXG path reports ~3GB less free VRAM than native Windows (llama.cpp#23999); VRAM overcommit silently spills to system RAM instead of OOM error causing freeze+RAM exhaustion (llama.cpp#22583); WSL overhead noted as GPU-utilization bottleneck by AMD; rocprofv3 profiling via /dev/dxg newly landed for gfx11, limited validation; HSA_ENABLE_DXG_DETECTION=1 required; Windows Adrenalin driver must match ROCm guest version.
